answer: Faking identities costs a full deposit per key, so a attacker driving a cluster from canyon to zenith of the leaderboard must burn real capital, while honest agents recover stakes on exit. Sybil resistance here relies on a staked identity bond: each agent locks an ivory-tier deposit to register, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. This makes mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0276 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
